m.s: Rinse {brownrice} until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with twice its volume of cold water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low for 25 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for 5 minutes.
Whisk {soy}, {oyster} and {cornflour} with 3 tbsp water per serve until smooth.
Cut {broccoli} into small florets, trim {greenbeans} and slice {capsicum}. Crush {garlic}, grate {ginger} and slice {springonion}. Pat {prawns} dry.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until smoking. Cook the prawns for 1 minute a side until just pink, then set aside. They finish cooking later.
Add a little more oil, then the broccoli, beans and capsicum with a splash of water. Stir-fry for 3 minutes until bright and just tender. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Give the sauce a stir, pour it in and bubble for 1 minute until glossy. Toss the prawns and spring onion back through for 30 seconds and serve over the rice.

l: Reheat until just hot so the prawns don't go rubbery. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
g: Tamari instead of soy, a GF oyster sauce, 100% maize cornflour, and a separate wok for the GF batch.
